title: Internal Enterprise Workflow Platform
subtitle: Reactive Full-Stack Web Platform & Background Automation
description: A full-stack internal enterprise platform built for Devotion Ventures to streamline operational workflows with real-time data synchronization, background job automation, and operator review gates.
longDescription:
Developed as an internal operational platform for Devotion Ventures, this system was engineered to coordinate high-volume data workflows and streamline internal operations.

The application is architected as a modern, reactive full-stack web system using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Convex as the real-time cloud backend. It enables instantaneous state updates across concurrent users without polling latency.

Key architectural capabilities include scheduled background jobs for task synchronization, asynchronous worker queues, automated status monitoring, and human-in-the-loop review gates for sensitive operations.

Note: As this is a private internal enterprise tool, proprietary workflows, internal endpoints, and live dashboards are not publicly accessible.
highlights: Architected reactive cloud backend services and scheduled cron jobs using Convex
Engineered real-time data synchronization and live-updating views for concurrent operators
Implemented asynchronous task pipelines and notification dispatch systems
Built structured operator review gates with approval workflows for sensitive actions
Developed an accessible, high-performance administrative interface in React and TypeScript
Maintained high standards for data privacy, security, and internal operational reliability
